findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 7 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 76 questions numbered 1-76; by section: 7.1 10, 7.2 5, 7.3 6, 7.4 5, 7.5 9, 7.6 6, 7.7 3, 7.8 6, 7.9 7, 7.10 7, 7.11 6, 7.12 6.

Covers sections 7.1-7.12 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use values changed from the book's examples and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise (no transverse-vs-longitudinal, constructive-vs-destructive, coherent-source, cardiac-Doppler or 10 Hz-beats question). Book corrections followed: Doppler shift of Case 2 is u_s/f with lambda_D = (v + u_s)/f; f3 = 3f1 of a closed pipe is the third harmonic; loud to faint in beats is half the beat period.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
